description_zh: 后车(ego)在夜间沿Bayshore Boulevard直行，追尾碰撞前方静止的Waymo AV(v2)。

source_snippets: While attempting a merge onto northbound Bayshore Boulevard from southbound Bayshore Boulevard, the Waymo AV came to a stop to yield for approaching traffic on the right. While stopped, a vehicle approached from behind and made contact with the rear bumper of the Waymo AV.
evidence.reason: 唯一在移动的车辆具有测试价值，选为ego；前方静止车辆作为前方停止车。符合追尾场景，可用rear_hit与stopped_ahead表达。
